English"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"In the PTC mode of the DeepSeek Harness (dsh), the model answers with a TypeScript program that call"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"s tools. This runtime runs each program in a fresh moejs runtime inside a sidecar process that stays"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" up between programs. A program with three tool calls takes 0.4 ms here, and 110 ms on dsh's Node ru"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ntime, which starts a Node process for every program."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Programs can wait on timers, import helper modules from the working directory and use `node:path`, `"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"node:util` and `node:timers`, and dsh's workflow tool runs its scripts here too."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Everything a program does to the machine is a tool call, which dsh runs with that tool's own policy,"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" approvals and sandbox. The sidecar itself only reads the code files a program imports, and it gets "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"the confinement dsh's Node runtime gives a program: the file sandbox of the Session's policy and the"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" same short environment. A run stops at its deadline, even in an endless loop, and when it goes past"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ment. A run stops at its deadline, even in an endless loop, and when it goes past its memory budget."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Performance"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Both runtimes ran the same program through dsh's `PtcRuntime` service API, mounted on dsh's own serv"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ices: three tool calls, each answered at once by its binding, and a returned object."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Runtime | Per call | Load to first result |
|---|--:|--:|
| dsh-ptc-moejs, workspace-write | 0.42 "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ms | 16.4 ms |
| dsh-ptc-moejs, danger-full-access | 0.42 ms | 6.8 ms |

Its parameters are the binding namespaces dsh passes (`t"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ools` in PTC mode), the error class of each namespace (`ToolCallError`, which carries the tool's nam"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"e in `toolName`) and `console` with `log`, `info`, `warn`, `error` and `debug`. `console` is also a "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"global, as are `setTimeout`, `setInterval`, `setImmediate` and their clear functions, so the modules"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" a program imports can use them; the binding namespaces are not. The rest is the JavaScript standard"},{"id":"p16s6","text":" library, which in moejs includes `TextEncoder`, `TextDecoder`, `atob`, `btoa`, `structuredClone` an"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"moejs includes `TextEncoder`, `TextDecoder`, `atob`, `btoa`, `structuredClone` and `queueMicrotask`."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The model writes a program like this one, and the runtime hands the returned value to dsh:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The returned value goes back to dsh as lossless JSON: plain objects, arrays, strings, finite numbers"},{"id":"p19s2","text":", booleans and `null`. A value that holds `undefined`, a function, a `BigInt`, a cycle, `NaN`, `Infi"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"nity`, `-0`, a `Date`, a `Map` or a class instance fails the run with `invalid-output`, and the mess"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"age gives the path of the first such member, for example `a BigInt at $.items[3].size`. A program th"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"at returns nothing completes with no value. Tool arguments follow the same rule, and a call with arg"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"uments that are not lossless JSON rejects inside the program before dsh sees it."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Failure kind | When |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| `exception` | The program or a timer callback throws, a promise rejects and nothing handles it, th"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"e program has a syntax error, or it uses TypeScript that changes run-time behaviour, such as `enum`."},{"id":"p21s3","text":" |

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- Every call starts with a fresh runtime. A persistent mode that keeps variables between calls, like"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" the Node runtime's REPL mode, is planned for a later version.
- The memory budget counts what a run"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" allocates, garbage included. A long run that builds and drops a lot of data can stop before its liv"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"e data reaches the budget.
- Values nest up to 10,000 levels deep in both directions, the depth moej"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"s's JSON reader and writer handle.
- `console` renders values with a port of Node 22's `util.inspect"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"`, with the options dsh's Node runtime gives it: depth 4, 100 items and 10,000 characters of a strin"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"g. Node 24 writes the symbol keys of an object without brackets. Node's `util.inspect` shows a proxy"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"'s target with `showProxy`, and the entries of an iterator and of a `WeakMap`, which moejs does not "},{"id":"p23s9","text":"expose.
- A run imports at most 256 files, each up to 1 MiB and 8 MiB in all. moejs has no import at"},{"id":"p23s10","text":"tributes, so JSON modules are not available. The program is the body of a function, so it imports wi"},{"id":"p23s11","text":"th `import()`, and `import` declarations work in the modules it imports.
- moejs interrupts running "},{"id":"p23s12","text":"JavaScript, and a compile runs to its end once it starts. A program that takes long to parse still e"},{"id":"p23s13","text":"nds at its deadline for dsh, and the sidecar drops the run once the parse returns.
- A promise that "},{"id":"p23s14","text":"rejects with no handler by the time the promise jobs of its callback run out fails the run, as an un"},{"id":"p23s15","text":"handled rejection ends the Node runtime's process. A tool call that the program never awaits fails t"},{"id":"p23s16","text":"he run that way when the tool fails, and so does an exception in an `async` timer callback. The mess"},{"id":"p23s17","text":"age starts with `Uncaught (in promise)`.
- The columns of the stack frames on a program's first line"},{"id":"p23s18","text":" count from the start of the function the program is the body of. The message of a failed run and `c"},{"id":"p23s19","text":"onsole` give the program's own columns; an error's `stack`, read by the program itself, still counts"},{"id":"p23s20","text":" from the function.
- CI runs the tests on Linux x64, Linux arm64, macOS arm64 and Windows x64 for e"},{"id":"p23s21","text":"very push. macOS x64 is untested: its binary is cross-compiled from the same source."}],"truncated":true}
